concept_decisions: Concept has smooth long sandy coastline and limited mouths; keep slight seaward arcuate bulge, few subdued beach ridges and sinuous river. Remove phototextured gridded plain, vegetation or overly deep coastal cliff. Construct low full-volume sediment tile with physical shore, incised main channel, small second distributary, opaque shallow water surface below banks. Ocean occupies front of footprint; no overlapping coplanar land/water surfaces. Subtle longshore ridges integrated into terrain rather than separate floating stripes. No radial wedge regular fan.
